description: List all templates for the authenticated user. Returns template summaries with optional layer details. Use the tag parameter to filter by folder/tag.

include_layers.description: Whether to include full layer details (default: false, faster without layers)

limit.description: Maximum number of templates to return (default: 100)

skip.description: Number of templates to skip for pagination

tag.description: Filter to templates that have this tag (case-insensitive)

name: layerre_list_templates
title: List templates
